ISS.Desc:
The International Space Station (ISS)
is the one place in space that humans have
occupied since the year 2000. It is the
joint effort of many different nations
coming together to do research in
microgravity.

There are currently 7 people abord
as of Oct 30 2026:

- Jessica Watkings(USA)
- Luke Delaney(USA)
- Joshua Kutryk(Canada)
- Sergey Teteryatnikov(Russia)
(which are part of the Crew-13 Mission)

- Pyotr Dubrov(Russia)
- Anna Kikina(Russia)
- Anil Menon(USA)
(which are part of the Soyuz MS-29 Mission)

Tiangong.Desc:
Tiangong or the Chinese Space Station(CSS)
is the Spacestation that is built and
operated solely by China. First launched
in 2021, it is much newer than the ISS and
is intended to last longer.

There are currently 3 people abord
as of Oct 30 2026:

- Zhu Yangzhu
- Zhang Zhiyuan
- Lai Ka-ying
(which are part of the Shenzhou 23 mission)

SATGUS.Desc:
SATGUS is a satellite launched by SpaceX
backin January 2025 as a part of
Crunchlabs™' efforts to inspire future
engineers.

Its purpose is to recieve images from
the Earth, display them on orbit, and
take a "selfie" with the Earth in
the background.

As of Oct 30 2026 its status is marked
as Inactive on the n2yo website.
